TanStack Router file route.description:
Declare a file route and its component. The path argument is rewritten by the route generator to match the file's location. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

声明文件式路由及其组件；路径实参由路由生成器按文件位置改写；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute。

TanStack Router file route with dynamic.description:
Declare a route with a dynamic segment, load by it and read it in the component. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

声明带动态段的路由，按该段加载数据并在组件中读取；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute。

TanStack Router file route with optional.description:
Declare a route whose leading segment may be absent; the param is then undefined. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

声明前导段可缺省的路由，缺省时该参数为 undefined；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute。

TanStack Router splat route.description:
Match the rest of the pathname and read it from the _splat param. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

匹配剩余路径，并通过 _splat 参数读取；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute。

TanStack Router layout route.description:
Declare a route that wraps its children; the children render at the Outlet. Requires createFileRoute and Outlet from @tanstack/react-router.

声明包裹子路由的布局路由，子路由渲染在 Outlet 处；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute 与 Outlet。

TanStack Router pathless layout route.description:
Declare a layout that groups routes without adding a URL segment; the file name starts with an underscore. Requires createFileRoute and Outlet from @tanstack/react-router.

声明不产生 URL 段的分组布局，文件名以下划线开头；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute 与 Outlet。

TanStack Router lazy file route.description:
Put the component of a route in a .lazy file so it is loaded on demand; the non-lazy file keeps loader, beforeLoad and validateSearch. Requires createLazyFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

把路由组件放进 .lazy 文件以按需加载，loader、beforeLoad 与 validateSearch 留在非 lazy 文件里；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createLazyFileRoute。

TanStack Router route module (TypeScript.description:
Complete route module with loader, component, error and pending states. Requires @tanstack/react-router and a request function of your own.

完整的路由模块，含 loader、组件、错误与等待状态；需要 @tanstack/react-router，以及自建的请求函数。
